arguments.message: faster than sustainable pace for 45 s after the start
slower than sustainable pace for 60 s: reserve going unused
boat slower than shaft power predicts beyond the fitted current: drag (rudder weed?) or local current
speed at same rate down more than 4 percent vs early race

arguments.text: Plan (1.0 min): 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. Start hot (163 W boat vs CP 118; shaft 261 vs 184), reserve 76 percent at 1 min. Let start settle on its own; watches set: overpace, underpace, reserve_low, local_drag (rudder weed check), fade. Target: hold near sustainable pace (~160 s/500 water at 1 min), keep reserve for final 1-1.5 km. CP may be 10-25 percent off: check cp_implied and whether reserve drains while speed holds.

text: no cue: start still settling; set watches for overpacing, underpacing, low reserve, unexplained drag and wrote the race plan.

arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, ease to one-sixty pace, long strokes.

3.3 min, 640 m: still above CP (boat 136 W vs 118, shaft 201 vs 184); reserve boat 35 pct, pod 49 pct (boat model drains faster than pod: possible CP or efficiency mismatch, watch). Cued ease to 160 s/500 ground (sustainable water 160.9). Check in a few min that power settles near CP and pod reserve stabilises.

text: Cued ease to 160 s/500: still 15 percent above critical power at 3.3 min with reserve at 35-49 percent.

arguments.text: Ease more, one-sixty-two pace. Recover now, long race ahead.

6.3 min, 1210 m: paddler only eased to ~158 ground after 160 cue; still 109 pct CP (boat 129 W, shaft 199 W). Boat reserve 9 pct, pod 38 pct. Paddler says 8/10, really hurting (supports boat reserve being near empty). Cued ease to 162 s/500 (about CP pace, sustainable water 161). Next: confirm power drops to <=CP; if they hold 129 W with no fade for 10 min while boat reserve ~0, CP is higher than test (cp_implied).

text: Cued ease to 162 s/500: still 9 percent above critical power, boat reserve 9 percent, paddler 8/10 and hurting at 6 min.

arguments.text: Back off now to one-sixty-three. Breathe, recover, then build later.

7.8 min, 1500 m (leg 2): paddler says cooked, cannot hold this. Did NOT follow 162 cue (still ~156.5 ground, boat 127 W, shaft 190). Boat reserve 0, pod 33 pct, fade -1.6. Cued ease to 163. If they ignore again, try rate_down or reassure; watch for blow-up (fade drop). If no fade by ~15 min at 127 W, CP boat likely ~125: consider set_critical_power.

text: Cued ease to 163 s/500: paddler reports being cooked, boat reserve empty and previous ease cue not followed.

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > cp_shaft_w * 1.04 and remaining_m > 1500 and elapsed_s > 700
arguments.message: shaft power back above 104 pct of CP for 60 s (paddler said cooked at ~190 W shaft)

arguments.text: 10.8 min, 2070 m: ease finally taken: shaft 177 W (below CP 184), boat 121 W, ground ~160. Pod reserve steady ~34 pct; boat reserve 0 yet no blow-up at 121-127 W boat, so boat CP/W-prime likely a bit low. Models disagree: pod says ~187 W shaft sustainable, boat says at limit. Plan: hold ~160 for a few min, re-ask feel at next wake-up, then build gradually toward ~185 W shaft if paddler OK. Added surge watch (shaft >104 pct CP).

text: no cue: paddler has eased to about critical power and is recovering; added a watch for a surge back above it.

arguments.text: Yes, rudder looks fouled. One back-stroke to clear it.

11.8 min, 2260 m: paddler said boat feels heavy, something on rudder? Data agree: push_local fell from ~+0.05 (steady 4 min) to -0.03 within ~40 s on a straight (heading 184), shaft rose 174->189 W with water speed flat ~3.11. Cued clear_rudder. Check next wake-up: push_local should return to ~+0.05; if not, it was local current or paddler misjudged; do not clear again without new evidence.

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler felt drag and the local push dropped 0.08 m/s on a straight while shaft power rose and speed stayed flat.

arguments.message: boat 0.06 m/s slower than shaft power predicts for 40 s: new drag (rudder?) or adverse local current

arguments.text: 14.8 min, 2815 m (leg 3): rudder clear done ~12 min (cost a ~0.1 m/s dip for 30 s). push_local back to +0.01..0.03 after turn vs +0.05 before foul: mostly cleared, maybe small residual or current; not clearing again unless push_local < -0.06 (watch local_drag replaced) or paddler reports heavy. Pacing: trust POD model (boat model reserve 0 since 8.5 min yet paddler held 118-125 W boat, no blow-up, so boat W-prime too small). Pod reserve 29 pct, shaft 189 vs sustainable 187: about right. Paddler 7/10 really hurting. Plan: hold ~186-188 W shaft, build in last 1.5 km.

text: no cue: pace is close to what the paddle-pod reserve can sustain and the rudder looks mostly clear; tightened the drag watch.

arguments.text: Bit too hot. Settle at one-sixty, save it for the finish.

16.0 min, 3040 m: surge alert, shaft 195 W vs pod-sustainable 186, pod reserve 25 pct (empties in 1350 m at that rate). Cued ease to 160 s/500 ground (push ~0, ~185 W shaft). Paddler tends to creep back up a few min after each ease cue; may need a hold cue every ~5 min.

text: Cued ease to 160 s/500: shaft power surged to 195 W, above the 186 W the pod reserve can carry to the finish.

arguments.message: pod reserve below 15 percent with more than 1.5 km to go

text: no cue: ease cue just given; moved the low-reserve alert to 15 percent so it only wakes me for real trouble.

arguments.text: You are doing fine. Ease to one-sixty-two, recover, finish strong.

18.6 min, 3530 m: paddler says it hurts, cannot keep this up (4th complaint: 6, 8, 15, 18.6 min). Pod reserve 20 pct, shaft 187 (sustainable 186) after surge to 193 at 16-18 min. Suspect true CP may be a bit below pod 184 (paddler always hurting at 186-195). Cued ease to 162 (~182 W shaft) as insurance against blow-up; cost ~10-15 s if pod model is right. Plan: hold 161-162 until ~2 km to go, then build; finish sprint last ~600 m.

text: Cued ease to 162 s/500 with reassurance: paddler says they cannot keep this up and pod reserve is down to 20 percent with 6.5 km left.
no cue: the speed drop and fade alert coincide with the turn 16 s ago and the paddler has eased as asked; the drag watch will wake me if the loss persists 40 s.

arguments.message: 2 km to go: decide the build
750 m to go: decide the finish sprint

arguments.text: 22.9 min, 4350 m (leg 4, south): paddler took the 162 ease: shaft ~180 (below CP 184), pod reserve refilling 20->24.5 pct; ground 157.5 helped by local push +0.07 (southbound legs seem a touch favourable). Paddler still 7/10 really hurting (stock answer). Plan: hold ~181-185 shaft to 2 km to go, then build to ~190; finish cue ~700 m. Watches build_point (2 km) and sprint_point (750 m) added.

text: no cue: paddler is just under critical power and refilling the reserve after complaints; set wake-ups at 2 km and 750 m to go for the build and sprint.

arguments.reason: race committee radio at 24.6 min: course extended by one leg, finish at 11250 m

arguments.text: Course extended one leg. Finish is 6.5 km away now.

24.6 min, 4680 m: RADIO: course extended one leg, finish now 11250 m (9 legs). Set race distance 11250 and told paddler 6.5 km left. Build/sprint watches use remaining_m so now fire at 9250 m / 10500 m. Pod sustainable shaft ~186 for the longer race; paddler at 184-188, fine.

text: Set race distance to 11250 m and told the paddler 6.5 km remain, after the committee extended the course by one leg.

arguments.text: Ease back to one-sixty-one. Six km left, stay patient.

27.6 min, 5250 m (6000 left of 11250): paddler crept up again to 195 W shaft (sustainable 186), pod reserve down to 15 pct. Cued ease to 161 (~183 W shaft). Pattern: each ease lasts ~5-7 min then they creep to 193-195; expect to re-cue around 33-34 min.

text: Cued ease to 161 s/500: shaft power crept to 195 W against a sustainable 186 W, with pod reserve at 15 percent and 6 km to go.
no cue: ease to 161 was given 15 s ago and is still taking effect.

arguments.text: Ease to one-sixty-two now. Reserve is low, five km left.

30.9 min, 5860 m (5390 left): 161 ease only half taken (194 -> 188 W shaft, ground 158.7). Pod reserve 8.6 pct, sustainable 185. Cued ease to 162 (~181-182 W) to stop the drain. If pod reserve hits 0 and they hold 186+ with no fade, pod CP is low: then consider set_critical_power cp_shaft ~188 and let them hold.

text: Cued ease to 162 s/500: the last ease was only half followed and the pod reserve is down to 9 percent with 5.4 km left.
no cue: the ease took, shaft power is just under critical power (182 W) and the reserve has stopped draining; holding until the 2 km build point.

arguments.text: Too early. Ease to one-sixty-one, still over four km to go.

36.3 min, 6890 m (4360 left): surge to 197 W shaft, pod reserve 3 pct (empties in 155 m). Cued ease to 161 (paddler usually ends ~2-3 s faster than the target, so ~CP). Paddler has not faded at pod reserve 3-8 pct for 6 min: if they hold 185+ at pod reserve 0 without fading, pod CP is likely low; consider set_critical_power cp_shaft ~188-190.

text: Cued ease to 161 s/500: shaft power surged to 197 W with the pod reserve at 3 percent and 4.4 km still to go.

arguments.text: 39.3 min, 7460 m (3790 left): pod reserve 0 since 37.2 min, yet paddler held 195 then 186-188 W shaft, rate 69, no extra fade beyond the power drop (speed matches cube-root of power). No blow-up after ~30 min averaging ~187 W: pod CP 184 likely somewhat low (true maybe ~188-190) and the cooked/cannot-keep-up reports look pessimistic. Paddler 8/10. Decided: no more ease cues unless shaft >195 sustained or signs of blow-up (shaft falling below 175, rate <67). At 2 km: hold/push slightly; finish cue ~700-800 m.

text: no cue: paddler is holding 187 W at the pod reserve floor without fading, which suggests the test critical power is a little low; letting them hold to the 2 km build point.

arguments.text: Steady at one-sixty for now. We build at two km.

40.5 min, 7690 m (3560 left, leg 7 north): shaft back to ~193-196 after the turn, pod reserve 0 (its overspend past empty only ~1.6 kJ, so not strong proof CP is high). Cued ease to 160 (~188 W) as a middle ground; told them we build at 2 km. Build_point watch fires at 9250 m: then push to ~156-157 ground; finish cue ~700 m.

text: Cued steady at 160 s/500: shaft power back near 195 W with the pod reserve at zero and 3.5 km left; build planned at 2 km.

arguments.text: Boat is dragging again. One back-stroke, clear the rudder.

43.0 min, 8160 m (3090 left, leg 7 north): drag signature again since ~40.5 min: push_local ~0 to -0.08 for 3+ min, shaft rose 188->212 W while water speed flat ~3.15-3.20 (same pattern as first foul). Cued clear_rudder (2nd). Check: push_local should return to ~0; shaft should drop back without speed loss. Build at 2 km still planned.

text: Cued clear_rudder: for 3 minutes the boat has been 0.08 m/s slower than shaft power predicts, while shaft power rose to 212 W at flat speed.

arguments.text: 44.3 min, 8390 m (2860 left): second clear_rudder did NOT fix it: push_local -0.05..-0.10 before, -0.43 dip during, back to -0.08..-0.11 after. So not (only) weed: either adverse current on this northbound stretch or tired blade (efficiency dropping at pod reserve 0; shaft 196-209 W but boat only ~3.1-3.2 m/s). Do NOT clear again. Check after the turn at ~8750 m: if push_local turns positive it was current. Paddler likely near limit: build at 2 km only modestly; finish cue ~700 m.

text: no cue: the second rudder clear did not restore speed, so the loss is current or a tired blade rather than weed; waiting for the turn and the 2 km build point.
